title: SFE-O: An Ontology for Knowledge-Grounded AI in Supercritical CO$_2$ Biomass Extraction and Fractionation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supercritical CO$_2$ extraction (CO$_2$-SFE) offers a sustainable route for recovering high-value compounds from biomass while limiting the use of conventional organic solvents, but its design and interpretation require heterogeneous knowledge spanning biomass properties, operating conditions, mass transfer, and product fractionation, typically fragmented across technical reports, engineering models, external databases, and expert practice. This paper introduces SFE-O, a modular Web Ontology Language (OWL 2) ontology for supercritical CO$_2$ biomass extraction, structured around interconnected Biomass, Process, and Product dimensions and extended with explicit representations of process topology, parameter provenance, external and internal mass-transfer phenomena, and the Constant Extraction Rate (CER) / Falling Extraction Rate (FER) mechanisms. translated_title: SFE-O：一种面向超临界CO₂生物质萃取与分级的知识驱动AI本体
translated_abstract: 超临界CO₂萃取（CO₂-SFE）为从生物质中回收高价值化合物提供了一条可持续的途径，同时减少了传统有机溶剂的使用，但其设计与解读需要跨越生物质特性、操作条件、传质和产物分级等异构知识，而这些知识通常分散在技术报告、工程模型、外部数据库和专家实践之中。本文提出了SFE-O，一个用于超临界CO₂生物质萃取的模块化网络本体语言（OWL 2）本体，围绕相互关联的生物质、过程和产物三个维度构建，并扩展了对过程拓扑、参数来源、外部与内部传质现象以及恒定萃取速率（CER）/下降萃取速率（FER）机制的显式表示。过程各物理量之间的计算依赖关系被显式地表达出来，而无需嵌入……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出SFE-O——一个基于OWL 2的模块化本体，通过生物质、过程、产物三大维度及传质机制和计算依赖关系的显式建模，为超临界CO₂生物质萃取与分级的知识驱动AI应用提供了统一的知识基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SFE-O, a modular OWL 2 ontology that explicitly models interconnected biomass, process, and product dimensions—including mass-transfer phenomena, CER/FER mechanisms, and computational dependencies—to provide a knowledge foundation for AI in supercritical CO2 biomass extraction and fractionation.
